title: PDF to Excel – Convert PDF Tables to XLSX Free, No Upload
description: Convert PDF tables to an Excel spreadsheet in your browser: one sheet per page, text in columns goes into cells, numbers stay numbers. No upload.
heading: PDF to Excel
subtitle: Get the tables of a PDF into an Excel spreadsheet, one sheet per page, with numbers you can add up; nothing is uploaded.
intro: Convert PDF to Excel online for invoices, statements and reports: each page becomes a sheet, every line of the page a row, and text that sits in columns goes into separate cells, lined up across the page. Numbers like 1,240 or (35.00) become real numbers you can sum and sort. Arabic pages give right-to-left sheets. Your file never leaves your device.

features.title: Private
features.text: Your file is handled by your own browser and never sent to a server, so nobody else sees it.

features.title: Cells, not text
features.text: Columns of the page become columns of the sheet, row by row.

features.title: Real numbers
features.text: Thousands separators and brackets are read, so totals and sorting work at once.

stepsTitle: How to convert PDF to Excel

steps.title: Choose your PDF
steps.text: Click Choose a file, or drop a PDF on the page.

steps.title: Download
steps.text: Download the .xlsx file and open it in Excel, Numbers or Google Sheets.

handles: Tables laid out in columns, row by row.
Numbers with thousands separators, decimals and negative numbers in brackets.
Bold rows, such as headings and totals.
limits: Columns are found from where text starts; cells that span several columns or wrap onto two lines may land in the wrong cell.
Every page becomes its own sheet, even when a table continues on the next page.
Scanned PDFs hold pictures of pages, so there is no text to read (that needs OCR).
PDFs that need a password to open must be unlocked first, with Unlock PDF.

faq.question: Is my file uploaded?
faq.answer: No. Your file is read and changed by your own browser, on your device, and is never sent anywhere. You can check it: open your browser's network panel while you use the tool and you will see no upload.

faq.question: How are the columns found?
faq.answer: From where pieces of text start across the page: text that starts in the same place on different lines goes into the same column.

faq.question: Are numbers kept as numbers?
faq.answer: Yes. Numbers like 1,240, 35.50 and (35.00) become numbers, so you can add them up and sort them.

faq.question: Does it work with scanned PDFs?
faq.answer: No. A scanned PDF holds pictures of pages, so there is no text to convert; that needs text recognition (OCR), which this tool does not do.

faq.question: Can I check the result before opening Excel?
faq.answer: Yes: open the downloaded file in the OpenAnyDoc Excel viewer, in your browser.

faq.question: Is it really free?
faq.answer: Yes. There is no account, no watermark and no limit on how often you use it.

faq.question: How do I convert a PDF to Excel without uploading it?
faq.answer: Use a converter that runs on your own device: OpenAnyDoc turns a PDF into an Excel .xlsx file in your web browser, so the file is never uploaded. Choose the PDF, click Convert to Excel and download the file; each page becomes a sheet and text in columns goes into separate cells.
